latestVersion.changelog: Native --detach / --status / --stop for gno serve and gno daemon (gno 1.2.0). New flag table + dedicated `### gno daemon` section in cli-reference.md teaches agents the full lifecycle: --pid-file, --log-file, --status (with --json gating), --stop (silent NOT_RUNNING), and exit code 3. Mutual exclusion of --detach/--status/--stop documented. Live-foreign (version-mismatched detached process) handling explained. Windows --detach gated with WSL guidance. Replaces all stale `nohup gno daemon` recipes.
